summary.text: Steve Nass is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Senate representing District 11, based in Whitewater, and has been elected to the Senate since 2014.
He chairs the Committee on Administrative Rules and co-chairs the Joint Committee for Review of Administrative Rules.

paragraphs.text: Nass was born in Whitewater, Wisconsin, on October 7, 1952.
He graduated from Whitewater High School, earned a B.S. from the University of Wisconsin-Whitewater in 1978, and received an M.S.Ed. in school business management from the same university in 1990.
The Legislature's page lists him as the owner of a rental property business and a former payroll benefits analyst and information analyst and negotiator.
It says he is a retired chief master sergeant of the Wisconsin Air National Guard with 33 years of service and served in the Middle East in Operations Desert Shield and Desert Storm.
He was elected to the Whitewater City Council from 1977 to 1981 and to the Assembly from 1990 to 2012, and has been elected to the Senate since 2014.
